email.subject: Summit – two separate charges
email.body:
Hi Accounting,

I have two back-charges from yesterday at Summit Medical Office.

Ridgeline Drywall left debris in the stairwell that cost us $360 to remove. Harbor Mechanical also damaged a sprinkler access panel during duct installation; replacing it cost $725.

Please record these as two separate charges against the respective subcontractors.

Thanks,
Dana
